description: How much house can I afford: maximum home price and loan from income, monthly debts, down payment and rate under front-end / back-end debt-to-income limits (default 28/36), with a full monthly PITI breakdown (principal & interest, property tax, insurance, HOA, PMI below 20% down). Give homePrice instead to get the monthly cost and the income needed. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/mortgage-affordability

homePrice.description: Optional: evaluate this price instead of solving for the maximum

monthlyDebts.description: Other monthly debt payments (cards, car, student loans)

pmiPct.description: Annual PMI, percent of loan, when down payment < 20%

propertyTaxPct.description: Annual property tax, percent of price
